integrity: The proof uses explicit published probability bounds and an asymptotic uniformity argument; no numerical experiment is used to certify the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The result is an achievability statement for the adaptive-interference protocol of arXiv:2610.01555v1 and does not prove that the vanishing-gap scale is necessary or optimal.
The statement concerns closed finite-dimensional unitary dynamics and the dynamical TRS condition, not open channels or antiunitary operator invariance.
title: Vanishing-resolution regime for ancilla-free dynamical time-reversal certification
